description: Lists visible non-archived campaigns in your organization, with status, brand context, the channel when set, the date it was created when known and the creator counts on each campaign line. The channel is TikTok Shop affiliate for a campaign that tracks TikTok Shop affiliate sales, else its platforms (Instagram, TikTok); a campaign with neither shows no channel. The counts are the creators found by its latest creator search and the creators on its roster. A campaign with no found count says why instead: no finished creator search when it has none, else the state of its latest creator search (still running, awaiting review feedback, finalized, stopped or did not finish). None of these means the search found nobody; only 0 found means that. These lines, across every page of this list, carry what picks the most recent campaign, or a campaign by channel or by the most candidates. The structured content lists each campaign's name and campaign_id in line order. Example: no arguments.
name: list_campaigns
title: List Campaigns
